facts.fact: Cybernetica says the UXP-based secure data exchange platform connecting Beninese government registries was built 2019-2021, was fully up and running in one year, and is still maintained.
Cybernetica says that as of 2024 more than 50 government institutions exchange data digitally through the platform to provide over 270 digital services.
Cybernetica says the platform carries more than 3 million monthly information exchanges as of 2024.
